entries.prompt: Local prop edit of this EXACT first frame. Keep ALL people, faces, poses, hand positions, every piece of furniture, notebook state, camera/laptop, all stage feet inside round platform, lighting and camera IDENTICAL. Correct ONLY the BLACK CURTAIN FABRIC. The thin diagonal rod held by the man from LOW viewer-LEFT to HIGH viewer-RIGHT must be the TRUE BOTTOM HEM of this curtain, not a separate rod in front of a full curtain. DELETE ALL VERTICALLY PLEATED BLACK FABRIC BELOW that diagonal rod, including the vertical folds visible behind the man and behind/above the workbench notebook. Also REMOVE the long dangling strip on viewer-RIGHT of the high gripping hand: the cloth's right edge must taper inward from top-right crossbar to that hand/rod endpoint; below hand height nothing may hang to the right of his hand. All space below the diagonal hem must be smooth plain BLACK STUDIO BACKGROUND, existing clothes and existing desk/objects with no pleats. Keep curtain only in the polygon ABOVE the diagonal bottom hem, pleated/gathered upward. The high hand stays separated from vertical support pole by the existing black gap. Do NOT move the rod/hand, do NOT add arms, do NOT change stage furniture positions or bench feet. A single curtain with its lower edge attached along the diagonal rod, no extra fabric below. Do not remove human purple coat tails. No words or text, preserve full16:9 image.
